attempts.prompt:
用途：illustration-story；《毕节，雨停之前》第1—10天序章的完整剧情CG，不是立绘拼贴。统一画法：日系半写实视觉小说插画，成年中国人物，面部严格匹配正式角色参考，自然真实比例，细腻克制的绘画质感，旧物与衣料有生活纹理，灰青环境与实用暖光相融，不改成夸张动漫脸、3D玩偶或照片风格。横向16:9，目标1920×1080不透明PNG。所有重要脸、手和道具放在画面上方15%至62%范围，底部35%以非关键衣物、地面等自然场景延伸容纳将来的对白；不画任何文字、标注、对白框、界面、标题、边框、水印。人物与环境统一重绘，自然遮挡、透视和接触影，禁止把参考立绘直接贴入背景。
本张CG06：第10天下午回声大厅，谁都没有笑。图1为文文23岁短寸、圆脸和旧深灰维修夹克；图2为毛狼24岁微卷短发、橄榄轻外套暖灰内搭和成年面孔；图3借普通旧KTV前厅、柜台、廊道、旧软椅与木纹空间，但窗外一定重绘成阴雨下午，非夜景。紧邻文文左肩侧的平视中景，左前景见文文局部侧脸、圆润下颌、夹克肩及一只自然停在尺寸纸旁的手；右中景毛狼看着文文，刚讲完笑话却发现对方没笑，嘴角收住、尴尬而不恶意，不露夸张笑容。两张可见脸在画面20%至45%高度，桌上尺寸纸、放下的一支笔、压住纸角的装线材箱与两只停住的手集中在45%至61%高度。背景大厅留正常生活纵深但没有背景人脸。小满在店里、周栀和师匠已离开，不画她们或他；孟遥和叶岚留在画外，不为群像强行加人。相机仍在关闭的包里，最好不突出展示它；没有架设设备拍摄、手机群聊、卷尺已经拉开、拍肩、握手、和解笑、胜负庆祝、录用通知或恋爱争夺。两个人在停顿中仍各自有尊严，空气凝住的真实朋友与竞争者关系。
最后两张额外参考仅用于统一本批已采用CG02与CG08的绘画细腻程度、真实比例、旧环境质感和暖冷光融合。不能把这两张参考的小满、黄球球、理发店或包厢场景额外带入本张。以本张各自规定的人物和场景为准。镜头尽量用有环境纵深的中景，不要裁掉关键的手、道具或伞，所有比例自然，不用加黑条制作底部空间。
attempts.review: 人物与克制停顿成立；不采用首版，先去掉提前摆在桌面的卷尺，避免预示后续取尺动作。

attempts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: existing visual-novel narrative CG for 《毕节，雨停之前》, CG06 Mao Lang's honest confession, tenth day afternoon.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and the exact composition, environment, every pose and object reference. Input image 2 is ONLY the approved Mao Lang OPTION D IDENTITY / HAIR / CLOTHING reference, not a pose, expression, lighting, or background reference.
Primary request: replace ONLY the man sitting at the RIGHT of input image 1 (Mao Lang, currently olive jacket and gray shirt) with the exact same adult man identity shown in input image 2. Make his face recognizably that of Option D: narrow oval youthful natural face, softly tapered jaw without a sharp idol V chin, straight natural eyebrows, slender attentive eyes, moderate nose with rounded tip, natural lips; short black hair with cropped sides and fluffy irregular slightly wavy top/fringe. Copy the black crew-neck short-sleeve T-shirt, lower-hem multicolor outlined flower print, black trousers, and black wrist wrap from Option D; the flower print appears only on whatever lower shirt area is actually visible above/behind the desk. Remove the old olive outer jacket and gray undershirt from this man only. No hat, no mask, no extra jacket.
Emotion: Mao Lang has just admitted competing for the same job. Keep him quietly serious and slightly awkward, closed mouth, no smile and no teeth; maintain his original gaze toward the man in the left foreground. Do NOT copy the open-mouth smile from the identity reference.
Strict invariants: preserve the exact seated lean, torso placement, head position and head angle, forearm positions, visible hand anatomy and hand pose on the desk of image 1. Keep the man in the LEFT foreground completely unchanged: buzz-cut hairstyle, face profile, dark repair jacket, body, hands and scale. Exactly TWO men. Keep the original camera, crop, lens/perspective, subject sizes, counter, room, rain-streaked window, corridor, warm lamps, wet reflective floor, plants, keys, telephone, cup, ALL blank work papers/floorplan linework, pen and black cable/tool case exactly in their original positions and preserve their shapes. Keep the existing rainy afternoon interior lighting, gray-cyan exterior and warm amber practical lights; do not change it to a stage or another time of day. Preserve the existing grounded Japanese semi-realistic painted style and material detail.
Output: ONE opaque full landscape PNG at the original target aspect ratio about 16:9 (target native 1672×940); preserve composition and avoid zooming or expanding.
Avoid: changing any other person or prop, extra people, microphone or microphone stand, singing pose, camera prop, tape measure, new objects, readable text, labels, subtitles, logos, watermark, added lettering, collage, transparent background, extra fingers.

review.identity: Option D fluffy short black hair, natural narrow oval face, black lower-hem flower T-shirt, black wrist wrap; no hat, mask, olive jacket, or gray undershirt.
review.expression: Closed mouth, serious and slightly awkward, gaze at left foreground Wenwen; no smiling/teeth.
review.poseAndHands: Original seated lean and tabletop forearm/hand positions visually retained. Close crop reviewed; no obvious extra or malformed fingers.
review.otherCharacters: Buzz-cut Wenwen in left foreground visually retained with original dark jacket and pose.
review.sceneAndProps: Rainy lobby, camera composition, windows, corridor lamps, floor, plants, reception keys/telephone/cup, work paper, desk pen, black cable case visually retained. Exactly two men.
review.limitations: Generative edit preserves composition visually, not a pixel-locked edit. Clothing removal naturally reveals forearms; lower print extent adapts to the seated crop. No browser/game acceptance or narrative integration performed.

adopted.postprocessing: 无；保留内置imagegen原始输出字节
adopted.selectionAuthority: 用户明确选择Option D并授权替换全部毛狼资源；按此作一致性自审采用
adopted.dimensionNote: Target 1672x940, generated native output 1672x941. Preserved unaltered; no crop, stretch, or upscaling.

gameAcceptance.scope: CG06/CG09五视口与8处毛狼对白，另有CG综合专项检查

criticalRegions.coordinateSystem: 整张原图百分比[x,y,w,h]，左上原点
criticalRegions.method: 人工观察估计，非像素级分割；只作布局避让说明，不能直接当裁切参数

display.desktop: 独立完整画面区，与对白区分开；不可直接沿用底部35%覆盖式对白
display.mobile: 完整横图、留边、独立对白；无竖版、无拉伸
display.reason: 实际多张图的关键道具或手位于原图下部，已按分镜约定的超出目标时改布局方案交接
display.manualSmallScreenReview: 已逐张查看375×667截图；脸、动作及主要道具可辨；纸张细字不作识别要求

postGenerationReferenceChanges.note: 未改原素材；CG06已按下午独立绘制，不复制旧参考雨夜天色。
